mapper.select: select id, parent_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, permission_code, sort_no, status, create_time, modify_time from cms_sys_menu where status = 1 order by sort_no asc, id asc

select distinct m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.permission_code, m.sort_no, m.status, m.create_time, m.modify_time from cms_sys_menu m inner join cms_sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.id inner join cms_sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 1 order by m.sort_no asc, m.id asc
